text:
Sam R.: Partner SI asked for a compliance packet for their marketplace listing: SOC2 attestation, pen-test exec summary, HSM/KMS attestation, and completed supply-chain questionnaire. They also want a short note on export-control posture. Deadline: next Tue for their procurement.

Tara V. (sec): We can provide SOC2 PDF and a 1-page pentest summary. HSM attestation: request vendor-signed doc, redact serials. Export-control: confirm no restricted crypto exports in the attestation.

Jon M. (legal): I'll need to review any vendor attestation and the completed questionnaire before signing. No statements about "export approval" — only factual notes.

Ivy P.: I'll map their questionnaire to our standard responses and flag items needing input from sec/infra. Can we use a 10-day presign TTL? Partner prefers 14 days.

Tara V. (sec): 14 days OK for hardware/SI. Redaction rules: remove IPs, internal hostnames, serial numbers, customer IDs, and detailed exploit descriptions. Replace firmware specifics with "managed by vendor" where required.

Sam R.: Upload plan: originals -> s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/inbound/si-hw/ ; redacted bundle -> /outbound/si-hw/. Include README.txt explaining redactions and contact.

Ivy P.: Timeline: I'll draft answers by Fri noon. Tara, can you review redactions Fri afternoon? Jon, can you sign early next week?

Jon M. (legal): Yes. I'll plan to sign Mon. If anything mentions export controls, route to export@redwood.com.

Tara V. (sec): Once approved, we'll create presigned URLs. Command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/si-hw/compliance-package.zip --expires-in 1209600`

Sam R.: Noted. I'll log this in the marketplace tracker and set outbound retention=60 days.

Ivy P.: Drafts uploaded to inbound path and left `redaction_notes.md`.

Tara V. (sec): Reviewed and signoff on redactions. No raw vuln dumps included.

Jon M. (legal): Signed cover letter and questionnaire. Files moved to outbound.

Sam R.: Presigned links (14d) generated and sent to SI. Partner confirmed receipt and asked for a tentative co-announcement slot next quarter. We'll follow up separately.

Ivy P.: Adding a checklist to partnerships playbook so we reuse this flow.

Sam R.: Thanks team — thread closed unless anyone has follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
